verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's docs explicitly say passkeys stored in the vault can be autofilled through the browser extension. The extension also autofills matching login credentials, and the integrated authenticator generates rotating TOTP codes. However, no evidence explicitly shows the extension autofilling or copying TOTP codes into login fields, so that half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented browser-extension TOTP autofill, and independent or hands-on corroboration of TOTP and passkey autofill working in practice.
